item.text: {"search_note":"I found no 2024 primary or Reuters-backed source documenting Indian military operations where civilian protection, prisoner treatment, necessity, or proportionality could be directly evaluated. I also found no evidence of a 2024 Indian military campaign that would clearly implicate these IHL questions.
